acceptance: AE22 LF14 share (capture/lock/identity; gate closes at LF15) + AE27 closure (imported/raw template cases locked and staged)

behavior_contracts.P15.1/capture: Load captures every statically referenced raw fixture (attached rows, lexical when rows in any body, template cases) with confinement resolved before reading; missing/escape/symlink/absolute/oversize inputs fail the load. Check-time loading serves captured bytes; a later disk edit cannot change them.
behavior_contracts.P15.1/fixtures_sha256: can-fixture-tree-v1 + zero byte, UTF-8 byte path order over normalized manifest-relative paths, P2 u64-BE length framing, deduped paths, distinct paths retained, empty set hashes prefix alone. Required per lock entry; validated against the captured graph; failures never rewrite the lock.
behavior_contracts.P15.1/identity: Verification identity binds source/config (manifest+source SHAs), lock bytes (LockSHA256), fixtures, catalogue/runtime/compiler, options (schema+assertions+roots+timeoutMs). Revalidation (ensureFresh) reloads and compares the full snapshot, rejecting source/fixture/asset edits before publication.
behavior_contracts.P15.1/workers: Workers execute staged modules whose raw exchanges were embedded from captured bytes at check time; staged artifacts contain the captured fixture bodies.
behavior_contracts.AE27/staged-imports: Cross-package template expansion stages: substituted definition IR is tagged with its definition source ID so source-map spans validate against the definition file (previously failed closed with an out-of-range offset on vendor templates).
